correctness.rationale: The final theorem concerns the ordinary matching complex of K1 join C_n, n>=3, natural rim D_n, and rational homology in d=floor((n-1)/3), with rank B_n as in Vega. An edge matching has at most one spoke; matching faces split into independence faces of C_n and n spoke cones over Ind(P_{n-2}). For an invariant oriented face the fixed-face sign is (-1)^{number of chosen edge orbits}; signed Lefschetz and the known one-degree homology recover the character. Nonidentity rotations have no fixed spokes and their orbit conflict graph yields 2cos(pi*gcd(n,a)/3), including gcd 1,2 conventions. Odd reflections cancel their unique fixed-spoke link against rim orbits; even reflected axes give equal path polynomials. Averaging characters yields the four residue classes {2,5,10,11} modulo 12. I checked the actual frozen RESULT.md argument and verified its boundary cases and the finite direct signed character independently for n=3..10. Neither finite checking nor the downloaded verifier establishes the general homology concentration; Vega is the cited theorem.
